name: murphy-data
description: Call-forwarder to the parent repo's compose stack. No Node code lives here — this file exists so that `kedro run` and `npm run up` can be typed from the same directory.
//: The containers are declared ONCE, in the parent repo, because the databases are shared with the serving stack: two declarations would mean two Mongos, and nothing would guarantee the backend reads the database the pipeline wrote. `npm --prefix ..` runs the parent's script with the parent as CWD, which is what makes `--env-file .env.dev` and the relative -f paths resolve.
